page.overview:
Who is Amazoness Trainee?

Amazoness Trainee is a character version of the card, "Amazoness Trainee". She appears in the video game Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's World Championship 2011: Over the Nexus as a Tag Duel opponent, her Tag partner is Harpie Girl.

This character and Harpie Girl can be unlocked as Tag Duel opponents by Summoning "Five-Headed Dragon". Their Tag Team name is Girls-Only Duel.
